ttl.name: Rear Differential Side Gear Shaft Oil Seal (4WD)

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Differential Side Gear Shaft Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, tap a new side gear shaft oil seal into the differential carrier assembly to the standard depth.

item.ptxt: Tap the oil seal in evenly so that it goes in straight.
Do not tap the oil seal in too far.

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of MP grease No.2 to the oil seal lip.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Suspension Member Brace LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear suspension member brace LH with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Snap Ring LH

s2.ptxt: Install a new snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Shaft Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Face the snap ring opening downward.
Align the splines of the inboard joint assembly, and using a brass bar and hammer, tap in the drive shaft assembly evenly.

item.ptxt: When inserting, do not damage the oil seal.
Use the press-fit wall of the inboard joint assembly when tapping it in.
Do not strike the end of the outboard joint assembly with a hammer.

atten4.ptxt: Judge whether the drive shaft assembly is fully installed by the change in reaction force of the brass bar or the change in sound.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Axle Carrier LH

s2.ptxt: With a block of wood in between, jack up the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 until it is horizontal, and hold the rear axle carrier.
Install the rear axle carrier to the upper control arm assembly rear LH, and temporarily tighten the bolt and nut.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and turn the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Temporarily Tighten Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH to the rear axle carrier, and temporarily tighten the bolt and nut.

s-1.ptxt: Install Trailing Arm Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Install the trailing arm assembly rear to the rear axle carrier with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Temporarily Tighten Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Insert the stud of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH into the rear axle carrier, and temporarily tighten it with the nut.
Install the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH to the rear suspension member, and temporarily tighten it with the bolt and nut.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and tighten the bolt.

s2.ptxt: Fully tighten the nut of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Height Control Sensor Sub-assembly Rear (w/ Discharge Headlight)

s2.ptxt: Install the height control sensor assembly (rear) with the 2 bolts.
Connect the connector and engage the clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Stabilize Suspension

s2.ptxt: Lower the vehicle and bounce it up and down several times to stabilize the suspension.

s-1.ptxt: Fully Tighten Upper Control Arm Assembly Rear LH

s2.ptxt: With a block of wood in between, jack up the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH to the standard vehicle height condition as shown in the illustration to apply load to the rear suspension.
Tighten the upper control arm assembly rear LH with the 2 bolts and 2 nuts.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and tighten with the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Fully Tighten Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 LH

s2.ptxt: Fully tighten the installation bolt of the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Fully Tighten Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Fully tighten the bolt of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH (rear suspension member side).

item.ptxt: Hold the nut and tighten the bolt.
Perform the work with the vehicle on the ground.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH to the rear axle carrier with the 4 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Disc LH

s2.ptxt: ) Align the matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and install the disc.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the disc, select the installation position where the disc runout is minimal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH with the 2 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Do not twist the flexible hose.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3

s2.ptxt: Install the parking brake cable assembly NO.3 with the 2 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Parking Brake Lever Protector

s2.ptxt: Install the parking brake lever protector to the parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Install Speed Sensor Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Install the clamp.
Install the speed sensor rear LH with the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Using a chisel and hammer, stake the rear axle shaft nut.

s-1.ptxt: Add Differential Oil

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 10mm, remove the rear differential filler plug and gasket.
Add Hypoid Gear Oil SX.
Check the oil level.

atten4.ptxt: Within 0 to 5mm from the bottom edge of the rear differential filler plug hole

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 10mm, tighten the rear differential filler plug with a new gasket.

atten3.ptxt: When replacing the oil, recheck the oil level after driving.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Differential Oil

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 10mm, remove the rear differential filler plug and gasket.
Check that the oil level is within 0 to 5mm of the bottom edge of the rear differential filler plug hole.

item.ptxt: Too much or too little oil can cause problems.
Stop the vehicle on a level surface.

s2.ptxt: If the oil level is low, check for oil leaks, then add oil.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10mm, tighten the rear differential filler plug with a new gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Install Exhaust Pipe Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Compression Spring Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

atten3.ptxt: If it is less than the minimum, replace the spring with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Gasket Installation

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the exhaust center pipe assembly as far as it will go by hand.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s3.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe assembly front.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust center pipe assembly with the 3 exhaust pipe supports.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust pipe assembly front with the 2 bolts.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust tail pipe assembly with the bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that there is no significant difference in the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust center pipe assembly and exhaust tail pipe assembly at the front, rear, left and right.

Headlight Leveling Computer Assembly Initialization Procedure
Preparation for Headlight Aiming

item.ptxt: Perform the headlight aiming with the low beam.
When using a low beam tester, perform "Headlight Aiming Adjustment (Using Low Beam Tester)" and "Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Tester)".
If a low beam tester cannot be used, perform "Headlight Aiming Adjustment (Using Low Beam Screen)" and "Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Screen)".
For the high beam, perform "Headlight Aiming Adjustment (Using High Beam Tester)" and "Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using High Beam Tester)".
The adjustment procedure is shown using a 1m manual type headlight tester.

s2.ptxt: Adjust the tire pressure to the specified value.
Have 1 person sit in the driver seat.
Start the engine and keep the battery in a charging condition.
Set the leveling switch dial to 0. (Halogen type headlight)

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Aim Adjustment (Using Low Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: Set the distance between the tester and the headlight lens to the tester's specified value.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 10cm downward and 0cm left/right.
Align the condenser lens of the tester with the center of the headlight.

s2.ptxt: Take measures so that the light from the other headlight does not affect the measurement.

item.ptxt: The outer lens of the headlight is made of resin, so it may be deformed by heat if the procedure takes a long time.
If covering it with an opaque object, do not keep it covered for more than 3 minutes.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights on low beam.
Adjust the low beam aim according to the instruction manual of the headlight tester used.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the aiming screw in the tightening direction (when adjusting in the loosening direction, loosen it once and then tighten it again).

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: After adjusting the aim, inspect the luminous intensity with the headlight tester.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Aim Adjustment (Using Low Beam Screen)

s2.ptxt: Prepare a piece of thick white paper.
Prepare an aiming screen as shown in the illustration. (Discharge type headlight)
Prepare an aiming screen as shown in the illustration. (Halogen type headlight)
Set the distance between the tester and headlight lens to 3m.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Align the center of the tester condenser lens with the headlight center.
Align the center hole of the adjustment screen with the center of the tester condenser lens, and attach it with tape or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights on low beam.
If it deviates significantly from the reference line, adjust the low beam aim so that the cut-off line aligns with the reference line.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the aiming screw in the tightening direction (when adjusting in the loosening direction, loosen it once and then tighten it again).

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using Low Beam Screen)

s2.ptxt: Set the distance between the tester and the headlight lens to the tester's specified value.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 11cm downward and 23cm to the left.
Align the condenser lens of the tester with the center of the headlight.

s2.ptxt: Take measures so that the light from the other headlight does not affect the measurement.

item.ptxt: The outer lens of the headlight is made of resin, so it may be deformed by heat if the procedure takes a long time.
If covering it with an opaque object, do not keep it covered for more than 3 minutes.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights on low beam.
After aiming adjustment, inspect with the headlight tester.

atten4.ptxt: For an automatic type tester, measure the luminous intensity at the point of maximum intensity.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Aim Adjustment (Using High Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: Set the distance between the tester and the headlight lens to the tester's specified value.
Position the tester so that it squarely faces the vehicle.
Set up the headlight tester.

s3.ptxt: Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 1/5cm of the headlight center height downward and 0cm for both left and right. (LH headlight)
Set the angle adjustment knobs of the tester to 1/5cm of the headlight center height downward and 5cm to the left. (RH headlight)
Align the condenser lens of the tester with the headlight center.

s2.ptxt: Take measures so that the light from the other headlight does not affect the measurement.

item.ptxt: The outer lens of the headlight is made of resin, so it may be deformed by heat if the procedure takes a long time.
If covering it with an opaque object, do not keep it covered for more than 3 minutes.

s2.ptxt: Turn on the headlights with high beam.
Adjust the high beam aim according to the handling procedure of the headlight tester used.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the aiming screw in the tightening direction. (When adjusting in the loosening direction, loosen it once and then tighten it again.

s-1.ptxt: Headlight Luminous Intensity Inspection (Using High Beam Tester)

s2.ptxt: After adjusting the aim, inspect the luminous intensity with the headlight tester.
